changeSet.author: javakishore-veleti
changeSet.comment: Architecture left-nav sections as children of software_architecture.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO knowledge.knowledge_category (code, name, description, parent_id, sort_order) SELECT v.code, v.name, v.description, p.id, v.sort_order FROM knowledge.knowledge_category p CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('patterns', 'Patterns', 'Classic design pattern families.', 10), ('styles', 'Architecture styles', 'Monolith, modular, microservices, event-driven, serverless.', 20), ('data', 'Data & modeling', 'Models, consistency, and schema evolution.', 30), ('cloud', 'Cloud & infrastructure', 'Platform and infrastructure choices.', 40), ('databases', 'Databases & storage', 'Storage engines and topologies.', 50), ('events', 'Event systems', 'Queues, streams, and pub/sub.', 60), ('ai_systems', 'AI & agentic systems', 'Orchestration, RAG, evals, guardrails.', 70) ) AS v(code, name, description, sort_order) WHERE p.code = 'software_architecture' ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;
